'''Zak Arranda''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who survived the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and became a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. He was the son of [[Milessa Arranda|Milessa]] and [[Kalf Arranda]] and young brother of [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Zak and his older sister, [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], were born on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Zak was known as a risk-taker, due to his love of going "vert" on his [[Skimboard/Legends|skimboard]]. Zak and his sister were on a field trip off-planet when the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] destroyed Alderaan. Both children were later adopted by their [[Shi'ido]] [[Moloch Hoole|uncle's]] brother, anthropologist [[Mammon Hoole]], who was only related to them because his brother married the Arrandas' Aunt [[Beryl (Human female)|Beryl]]. They accompanied Hoole on his adventures as he studied the sapient races of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

===Project Starscream===
One of their early adventures led them to the planet [[D'vouran]], inhabited by the [[Enzeen]], where Zak, Tash, Hoole and the droid [[DV-9]] ran into a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Smada]], who seemed to know Hoole and wanted to make use of his shape-shifting abilities. As Smada ordered his [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] killers to vaporize the Arrandas, he was stopped by the intervention of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. The children were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and briefly encountered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. However, they were upset to find out their uncle had once worked for their worst enemy.

===Later life===
Both of the Arrandas received university training after the threat of the Empire had lessened and became anthropologists themselves. They also attended the [[Jedi Praxeum]] for a time before Hoole moved them to an undisclosed location, possibly [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]].
